content: Teddy Grahams are a type of graham cracker snack shaped like small bears, originally introduced by Nabisco in 1988. Over the years, the product has undergone various iterations, including a cereal version and a short-lived variant called Dizzy Grizzlies. Despite these changes, the core flavors of Teddy Grahams have consistently included cinnamon, honey, and chocolate. More recently, additional flavors such as chocolatey chip and oatmeal have been introduced. The iconic bear shapes of the snacks have remained largely unchanged, featuring two distinct designs: one with the bear’s arms raised and legs closed, and another with the arms lowered and legs open. Teddy Grahams have occasionally been featured in popular culture. They were used as a prop on Late Night with Conan O'Brien, referenced in an episode of The Simpsons, and mentioned in a Strong Bad email. Additionally, the snack was referenced in the song Ridin' Rims by Dem Franchize Boys. Nutritional Information Nabisco has marketed Teddy Grahams as a healthy snack option. However, this claim has faced criticism. A New York Times article by Marian Burros, titled Eating Well, highlighted that the snacks originally contained more bleached flour than whole wheat graham flour. In response to this critique, Nabisco increased the proportion of whole grain flour in the product. Teddy Grahams contain 0 milligrams of trans fat and are considered a good source of calcium and iron. Furthermore, according to PETA, the chocolate and cinnamon varieties of Teddy Grahams are vegan-friendly. Advertising In recent years, advertisements for Teddy Grahams have become rare. One of the most recent ads aired on PBS, featuring a toddler eating Teddy Grahams while running around the house. Historically, some of the most memorable advertisements were for the Teddy Grahams “Breakfast Bears” cereal and the limited-edition “Rockin’ Bears.” These commercials featured animated bear characters performing rock music to promote the snacks. Classic Jingles Several jingles were created to promote Teddy Grahams, including: 1. Original Teddy Grahams Jingle We just want to eat, tasty Teddy Grahams, Scrumptious bunch of bite-sized bears, full of golden graham. Oh, let them be, your Teddy Grahams. (Delicious graham snacks in honey, cinnamon, and chocolate.) Just want to eat those Teddy Grahams. 2. Breakfast Bears Jingle Wake up everybody. Wake up. You’ve all been sound asleep, woo, here’s breakfast bears to eat. (Introducing Teddy Grahams Breakfast Bears cereal.) Your dreams are over, it’s seven o’clock, Graham cereals they can’t be beat. (In honey, cinnamon, and chocolate, they’re scrumptious enough, And they’re part of this nutritious breakfast, ‘Cause they’re bursting with wholesome graham goodness.) Wake up to Breakfast Bears. 3. Rockin’ Bears Jingle (New Teddy Grahams Rockin’ Bears.) Tasting those Teddy Grahams. We got new shapes to savor; we love to munch the snacks. We got the graham, Teddy Grahams. New Rockin’ Bears in vanilla and chocolate too, The rockin’ taste is just for you. (New Teddy Grahams Rockin’ Bears, four new rockin’ shapes. On tour for a limited time only.) Woo woo, tastin’ those Teddy Grahams.
